cider.title: From our apple, natural cider.
cider.body: We grow organic apples in Aramaio and make our natural cider with them. During txotx season, January to May, we serve it straight from the kupela; the rest of the year, bottled.
cider.shop: Take home our cider and organic apple juice from our shop.

produce.title: Sagardoa, zukua eta sagarordea
produce.body: Gure 1.400 sagarondotako sagar ekologikoak, Iturrieta ECO sagardoa eta etxera eramateko zukua — Sagarretik txotxera.

season.title: Txotx!
season.body: Live the cider house experience: cider straight from the kupela, the grill and the friendly atmosphere.
season.bodySecondary: January to May — barrel cider, fire-grilled menu, and the txotx ritual in the kupela room.

music.title: Live music at the cider house

aboutSection.title: A family project in the mountains of Aramaio.
aboutSection.description: Iturrieta is a family farming project. In 1997 we moved from Vitoria to this beautiful farmhouse in Aramaio and turned the stables into a cider house, opening on St. James's Day 1998. Today we tend around 1,400 apple trees.
aboutSection.motto: Sagarretik txotxera — from apple to txotx, natural organic cider made at home.
aboutSection.imageAlt: Iturrieta farmhouse in the Arraga neighbourhood, Aramaio
